description: Boundary coverage for the predicate-driven retry decision: a predicate that declines immediately on the very first completed response settles the wrapper at once with that response; a predicate that approves several times before declining drives a longer retry chain governed solely by its returns; and a predicate consulted across a mix of a failed attempt and a later completed attempt receives the corresponding error-or-response arguments on each invocation before it finally settles the wrapper.

cases.expected_output:
retryOn_call attempt=0 error=none status=200
fetch_count=1
url=http://someUrl
options_passed=true
outcome=resolved status=200

retryOn_call attempt=0 error=a status=none
retryOn_call attempt=1 error=b status=none
retryOn_call attempt=2 error=none status=200
fetch_count=3
url=http://someUrl
options_passed=true
outcome=resolved status=200

retryOn_call attempt=0 error=boom status=none
retryOn_call attempt=1 error=none status=200
fetch_count=2
url=http://someUrl
options_passed=true
outcome=resolved status=200
